name: amfx-spx-vs-2y-yield-1994-analog
description: amFX reproduction (21DEC22 p6): SPX vs US 2-Year Treasury Yield 1992-1998 showing the 1994/95 rate cycle analog. Dual-line overlay: SPX (black) and 2Y yield (orange). Stocks struggled during aggressive 1994 rate hikes, then exploded higher once the Fed pivoted in 1995 — 'massive bull market.' Contrarian case for 2023. Source: amFX 21DEC22 newsletter (Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: SPX vs US 2-YEAR YIELD 1992-1998
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces page 6 chart from amFX 21DEC22 newsletter.
# Dual-axis overlay: Black = SPX (left axis ~400-1200)
# Orange = US 2-Year yield (right axis ~3.5%-8%)
# Key narrative: Stocks struggled as rates went up dramatically in 1994.
# As soon as the Fed turned... Massive bull market (1995-1998).
# This is the contrarian analog for 2023: if the Fed pivots,
# equities could surge despite bearish consensus.
# =============================================================================

# Use common_reference_stocks to provide timeframe anchor for FRED data
spy_o, spy_h, spy_l, spy_c, spy_v, spy_vw, spy_n = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.SPY)()

# =============================================================================
# DATA: S&P 500 from FRED (daily) —  for historical data
# =============================================================================
sp500_src = economic_indicators(series_id='SP500')()
sp500 = ffill(sp500_src.result)

# =============================================================================
# DATA: US 2-Year Treasury Yield from FRED (daily) —  for historical data
# =============================================================================
dgs2_src = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS2')()
dgs2 = ffill(dgs2_src.result)

# Time index
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: SPX and 2Y Yield Overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='1994 Rate Shock: Did Stocks Recover After the Fed Pivoted?',
    category='Rate Cycle Analog',
    y_axis_label='S&P 500 Index',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='S&P 500', color=Color.Black),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 2-Year Yield (%)', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, sp500, dgs2)
